scheme_name: Laptop Scheme for Meritorious Students of SC/ST
other_conditions: Applicant must be born in Goa
Applicant must have passed the class 10th examination of the Goa Board in the first attempt
Applicant must have scored at least 70% aggregate marks in the class 10th examination of the Goa Board
Applicant must be schooling in the taluka where he/she is considered meritorious
Male applicants must be among the top 5 male students of class 10th in their taluka
Female applicants must be among the top 5 female students of class 10th in their taluka
benefits_summary: A laptop is provided to eligible meritorious students.
